claims.claim: Most children start Reception in September after their fourth birthday
claims.quote: Most children start reception full-time in September after their fourth birthday.
claims.note: The admissions page states this usual Reception starting point.

claims.claim: Full-time education becomes compulsory on the first 31 December, 31 March or 31 August on or after the child’s fifth birthday
claims.quote: This is on 31 December, 31 March or 31 August following their fifth birthday - whichever comes first. If your child’s fifth birthday is on one of those dates then they reach compulsory school age on that date.
claims.note: The source gives those prescribed dates and includes birthdays that fall on one of them.
